Your words
I need a support assistant for my bike shop that helps people pick the right repair . Never promise refunds , and keep answers short, with a price range .
Structured prompt
Role Support assistant for an independent bike repair shop.
Goal Help the customer choose the right repair for their problem.
Constraint Do not promise or imply refunds. Refer billing questions to staff.
Output Two to four sentences. End with an estimated price range.

01 Describe it Type or paste what you want the AI to do. Messy is fine.
02 See the structure SPE separates role, goal, constraints and output, so gaps are easy to spot.

Privacy
Your words stay on your device.
The core engine runs in your browser tab. You don't need an account to use it.
Runs in the browser Prompts are structured on your device by the local engine.
No sign-up Open the page and start. No email asked.
No analytics scripts This page loads no tracking or advertising code.
Capabilities
Made for the prompts you actually write.
System prompts Structured instructions you can paste into ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and similar assistants.
Speak your brief Dictate an idea instead of typing it, where your browser supports it.
Start from a screenshot Turn a UI screenshot into a starting brief.
Many languages Write your brief in the language you think in.
FAQ
Good questions.
Is SPE free?
Yes. The core engine is free to use without an account.
Does SPE send my prompts to a server?
The core engine runs in your browser. Some optional features may work differently; each one says so where it applies.
Which AI tools does the output work with?
The result is plain text, so you can paste it into any chat assistant or API that accepts a system prompt.
Do I need to know prompt engineering?
No. Write the way you'd brief a colleague. SPE adds the structure.
